notes.title: The Future of BOK
notes.notes:
There hasn't been a BOK Update for a while, and i'm not too sure if anyone's super upset about that. I think it's fair to say that BOK is not a very good game, and as my game development skills grew (and so did my laziness), I came to realize that more and more.

[b][u]So here's the deal.[/u]
[/b]
I've started to make the game completely from scratch, because to be honest the state that it's in probably isn't recoverable. I didn't even know how to code when I started work on it, and I learned as I went on, which is probably one of the reasons why it's so terrible. My goal is to make it an actually fun game, with fun and interesting mechanics, and slightly less miserable to try to beat.

The challenge will most likely be removed, however if you like to suffer there will probably be some extra optional stuff that make the game harder. My goal is to make the game a fun challenging, not a miserable and boring challenging, if that makes any sense. 

I've already implemented a bunch of new features and stuff that I am actually pretty proud of, however I don't think I'll show any of it until I've finished a few levels. Maybe I could put a demo out for anyone who wants to try an early version. A bunch more mechanics involving movement and how the levels actually play out are things that I think are very necessary if I want the game to be actually fun, and so those are my main priorities right now. I want the game to be a lot less 1 dimensional, and I think I am getting there.

I genuinely think that I can make a fun game, and I don't want the current state of BOK to be a testament to the quality of games I can make. I have written down my entire plan for BOK and I have big dreams, so don't expect it for a really long time. I'm working on this myself, and I'm not professional game designer, I'm just a 15 year old kid who likes to make games in his free time. I want the game to actually be a fun challenge, with interesting mechanics and possibly even a story. For now I'm working on the basic stuff, so I will try to discipline myself and keep working on it.

[u][b]Pricing[/b][/u]

Almost forgot to mention this, but I will not post this remake as a seperate game. I will just update/replace the current version, and probably delete the current version because I don't think anyone will be too upset about that. I might make a free dlc or something to play the old version if anyone really cares all that much. I want the game to be worth the $3, so that's what I'm working towards. My intention in the original version was never to make a profit, however for some reason I charged money for this terrible game so I believe it is my duty to provide an experience worthy of the price tag. I won't be changing the price.

Thank you for being patient, not that you were really hoping for anything, but I promise this game will be fun, I won't be posting it until it is.

TL;DR:
I'm making BOK from scratch so that way it'll actually be fun, so don't expect anything new for a long while.

P.S. Nothing in the screenshot is final, in fact barely of it is.

notes.title: Big BOK Update!
notes.notes:
The new update is finally here!
This major update includes quite a few changes, however I didn't quite fit everything
I wanted into the update, so expect more updates in the future.

Here's a list of all of the changes, or at least the ones I remember:

2 New Gamemodes:

	-Limited Lives: Exactly like it sounds. Choose between easy, normal, or hard mode 
	and select the amount of lives you want to beat the game. (I would not recommend 1 life mode)

	-Speedrun mode: Race against your best time for specific levels, 
	or see how fast you can beat the entire game.

New Hats:

	-Purchase a construction hat, a flower, a beanie, or a lumberjack hat for new headwear.
	-Expect more hats to come soon

16 New Achievements:

	-9 New Achievements for Limited Lives accomplishments (that I bet some will never be achieved)
	-3 New Achievements for Speedrun mode times
	-3 New Secret Achievements...
	-1 New Achievement for purchasing the lumberjack hat

Sprite Revamp:

	-Most ground textures are revamped and revised, along with trees and backgrounds.
	-Rounded most corners, possibly making the game harder or easier in certain situations.
	-Enemy sprites and animation revisions soon!

Menu Revamp:

	-Gamemodes are now accessible in the play menu, making them easier to find
	-The conditions to unlock certain gamemodes are now listed
	
Other Small Changes:

	-Eggs in level 6, so you can max out your egg counter while you suffer
	-Checkpoints now save after you quit the game, however keep in mind that if you switch
	to a different level it will remove your progress in any other level.
	-You can hit the spacebar or the enter key to retry now (Majorly requested)

- Bug Fixes:

	-You can now see your hats in puddle reflections
        -No more super jumps on sloped ledges, which makes some parts harder
	-Ordering issues showing certain objects in front of others
	-Other small unimportant stuff that nobody probably noticed

That should be all, unless of course I forgot something.
Thanks for your patience and expect more to come soon!

notes.title: Big News!
notes.notes:
As the very active and thriving BOK community already knows, there has been a lack of activity on the developer side of things regarding the game.

I had an update planned with new achievements, game-modes, and more, however things didn't really go the way I planned. My laptop with all of the game files broke and wouldn't boot into windows! The only backup I had was of a way older version, and I lost inspiration after losing hours of progress on development (lesson learned).

However, I recently managed to fix my laptop and get the files back, meaning I can work on the game again! I'm sure the 4 people that have ever played the game are very happy right now. I was planning on just releasing the content I had already made, but I had worked on some new artwork during the time I couldn't access the files, and I think I will spend a little time polishing the game before I release the next update.

Here's a little preview of what to expect in the next update;

- New Gamemodes
- New Achievements
- [b]Major[/b] Graphics Update
- Bug Fixes
- Other QOL Improvements

Thank you for being patient, and hopefully it won't be long before the next update comes out!

TL;DR:
Sorry for not making updates, one will come out soon.
